items.heading: Liboke ya Mbisi
details: Key ingredients: fish, banana leaf, tomato, onion, chili
Season whole fish with tomato, onion, chili and herbs.
Wrap the seasoned fish tightly in banana leaves.
Steam or grill the parcel over low heat until the fish is cooked through.
Unwrap and serve the fragrant, tender fish with rice or fufu.

items.heading: Fufu with Pondu
details: Key ingredients: cassava flour, water, cassava leaves, palm oil
Whisk cassava flour into boiling water, stirring until stiff and smooth.
Knead the fufu dough in the pot until glossy.
Simmer pounded cassava leaves with palm oil and seasoning until tender.
Serve the fufu alongside the pondu greens.
